items.text: Arrived in the morning at the 24th St. Mission BART Plaza. Way more people out, lots of movement, street vendors, and just overall busy energy. Everything felt active and alive, easy to get where you need to go with plenty of foot traffic....

24th and Mission BART station sucks it’s very unsafe when entering the BART station be aware very nasty panhandle is everywhere selling merchandise all over the ground but that’s 24th for you stay aware of your surroundings! Mission Street...

There’s a giant police trailer and massive police presence on one side, where all the illegal sellers have been kicked out, but right across the street, it business as usual. What is the goal of this?   submitted by   /u/RolfWiggum...
